gaps: The return-period flood simulation has no future calendar horizon and is excluded under the bank's projected-evidence contract; the original claim remains in the extraction audit.
Refugee-host service and employment tensions remain separate contextual evidence. They are not joined to climate hazards, and migration/refugee status is not treated as a threat characteristic.
The ministry's local rankings have incomplete scenario, period and infrastructure detail; they are selected screening findings, not complete city-level or current household risk estimates.

executive_assessment.text: Named local depth differentiates urban rainfall, heat and drought classifications from historical wildfire-poverty overlap in Şanlıurfa and Mardin.

Refugee-host service, employment and cohesion evidence is retained with undated-population and project-design limits. The review did not establish a climate-conflict or reverse insecurity-to-adaptation pathway.

Seven named basins and Ceyhan have planned flood/drought capacity investments, while Samsun, Sakarya, Muğla and Konya have reported local-plan outputs. Planned reach and published plans do not prove reduced vulnerability.
